name: Department of Transport and Main Roads Women in Engineering Bursaries
provider: QUT and Queensland Department of Transport and Main Roads
summary: Bursaries for women in second or third year of a QUT Bachelor of Engineering who live in Queensland.
key: $5,000 each, offered to four continuing domestic students (2024 terms).
who: Full-time in a four-year Washington Accord accredited Bachelor of Engineering.
Australian citizen or permanent resident and a Queensland resident.
Second or third year, with a GPA of at least 4.0.
how: Apply with the application form, a CV and a 300-word statement on your interest in maths and physics and your leadership skills.
catches: The terms found are from 2024. The QUT listing was updated in September 2026, so check the current round.
